text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Platymantis pseudodorsalis as row Anf1126, within Platymantis, Ceratobatrachidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Platymantis pseudodorsalis 记为 Anf1126 行，所列属、科、目为 Platymantis、Ceratobatrachidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 29.8 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：29.8 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Platymantis taylori as row Anf1136, within Platymantis, Ceratobatrachidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Platymantis taylori 记为 Anf1136 行，所列属、科、目为 Platymantis、Ceratobatrachidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 33 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：33 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Atelognathus ceii as row Anf1141, within Atelognathus, Ceratophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Atelognathus ceii 记为 Anf1141 行，所列属、科、目为 Atelognathus、Ceratophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 44 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：44 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Atelognathus praebasalticus as row Anf1146, within Atelognathus, Ceratophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Atelognathus praebasalticus 记为 Anf1146 行，所列属、科、目为 Atelognathus、Ceratophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Telmatobius chusmisensis as row Anf1176, within Telmatobius, Ceratophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Telmatobius chusmisensis 记为 Anf1176 行，所列属、科、目为 Telmatobius、Ceratophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 63.2 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：63.2 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Telmatobius gigas as row Anf1186, within Telmatobius, Ceratophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Telmatobius gigas 记为 Anf1186 行，所列属、科、目为 Telmatobius、Ceratophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 109 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：109 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Telmatobius niger as row Anf1202, within Telmatobius, Ceratophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Telmatobius niger 记为 Anf1202 行，所列属、科、目为 Telmatobius、Ceratophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 77.6 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：77.6 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum size at sexual maturity: 52 mm; maximum size at sexual maturity: 54 mm; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 性成熟最小体长：52 mm；性成熟最大体长：54 mm；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Telmatobius sanborni as row Anf1213, within Telmatobius, Ceratophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Telmatobius sanborni 记为 Anf1213 行，所列属、科、目为 Telmatobius、Ceratophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 79.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：79.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Craugastor mimus 记为 Anf1289 行，所列属、科、目为 Craugastor、Craugastoridae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 58 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：58 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Craugastor phasma as row Anf1305, within Craugastor, Craugastoridae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Craugastor phasma 记为 Anf1305 行，所列属、科、目为 Craugastor、Craugastoridae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 50 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：50 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Craugastor psephosypharus as row Anf1310, within Craugastor, Craugastoridae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Craugastor psephosypharus 记为 Anf1310 行，所列属、科、目为 Craugastor、Craugastoridae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 65 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：65 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Craugastor rayo as row Anf1315, within Craugastor, Craugastoridae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Craugastor rayo 记为 Anf1315 行，所列属、科、目为 Craugastor、Craugastoridae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 71 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：71 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Craugastor rugosus as row Anf1320, within Craugastor, Craugastoridae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Craugastor rugosus 记为 Anf1320 行，所列属、科、目为 Craugastor、Craugastoridae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods; vertebrates, including cannibalism in the source definition as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物；脊椎动物，来源定义包括同类相食 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 69 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：69 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Craugastor saltuarius as row Anf1325, within Craugastor, Craugastoridae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Craugastor saltuarius 记为 Anf1325 行，所列属、科、目为 Craugastor、Craugastoridae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 22.4 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：22.4 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Craugastor stejnegerianus as row Anf1330, within Craugastor, Craugastoridae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Craugastor taurus 记为 Anf1335 行，所列属、科、目为 Craugastor、Craugastoridae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 80 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Alsodes hugoi as row Anf1351, within Alsodes, Cycloramphidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Alsodes hugoi 记为 Anf1351 行，所列属、科、目为 Alsodes、Cycloramphidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 70.7 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：70.7 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 355 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 656 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 4.6 mm. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：355 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：656 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：4.6 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Proceratophrys moratoi as row Anf1401, within Proceratophrys, Cycloramphidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Proceratophrys moratoi 记为 Anf1401 行，所列属、科、目为 Proceratophrys、Cycloramphidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags daytime; night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天；夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 35.7 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：35.7 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 50 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 129 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.7 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.4 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Cycloramphus fuliginosus as row Anf1434, within Cycloramphus, Cycloramphidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Cycloramphus fuliginosus 记为 Anf1434 行，所列属、科、目为 Cycloramphus、Cycloramphidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 64.3 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：64.3 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 42.1 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Cycloramphus semipalmatus as row Anf1444, within Cycloramphus, Cycloramphidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Cycloramphus semipalmatus 记为 Anf1444 行，所列属、科、目为 Cycloramphus、Cycloramphidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 50.9 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：50.9 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Ameerega altamazonica as row Anf1453, within Ameerega, Dendrobatidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Ameerega altamazonica 记为 Anf1453 行，所列属、科、目为 Ameerega、Dendrobatidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags twilight as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 晨昏 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 25 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：25 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 14 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 26 individuals/eggs. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：14 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：26 个/枚。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 18 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 31 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 4 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 7.5 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 7.5 mm. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Ameerega rubriventris as row Anf1477, within Ameerega, Dendrobatidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Ameerega rubriventris 记为 Anf1477 行，所列属、科、目为 Ameerega、Dendrobatidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 24.3 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：24.3 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 17 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 17 individuals/eggs. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：17 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：17 个/枚。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 49.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：49.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum lifespan: 15 years; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 24 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 66 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 3 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 3.2 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大寿命：15 年；每窝后代或卵的最小数量：24 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：66 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：3 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：3.2 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Ranitomeya claudiae as row Anf1545, within Ranitomeya, Dendrobatidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Ranitomeya claudiae 记为 Anf1545 行，所列属、科、目为 Ranitomeya、Dendrobatidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 13.4 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：13.4 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 3 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 4 individuals/eggs. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：3 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：4 个/枚。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Ranitomeya Duellmani as row Anf1550, within Ranitomeya, Dendrobatidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Ranitomeya Duellmani 记为 Anf1550 行，所列属、科、目为 Ranitomeya、Dendrobatidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum age at sexual maturity: 0.75 years; maximum age at sexual maturity: 1 years; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 2 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 10 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 性成熟最小年龄：0.75 年；性成熟最大年龄：1 年；每窝后代或卵的最小数量：2 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：10 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Ranitomeya tolimensis 记为 Anf1564 行，所列属、科、目为 Ranitomeya、Dendrobatidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The source flags daytime; twilight as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 18.9 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：18.9 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyloxalus bocagei as row Anf1578, within Hyloxalus, Dendrobatidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyloxalus bocagei 记为 Anf1578 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyloxalus、Dendrobatidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 29.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：29.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 28 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 50 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.3 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：28 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：50 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.3 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyloxalus leucophaeus as row Anf1599, within Hyloxalus, Dendrobatidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyloxalus leucophaeus 记为 Anf1599 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyloxalus、Dendrobatidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 26.1 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：26.1 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyloxalus vergeli as row Anf1626, within Hyloxalus, Dendrobatidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyloxalus vergeli 记为 Anf1626 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyloxalus、Dendrobatidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 27 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：27 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 90 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1187 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.6 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.6 mm. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Fejervarya keralensis as row Anf1646, within Fejervarya, Dicroglossidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Limnonectes arathooni as row Anf1675, within Limnonectes, Dicroglossidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Limnonectes arathooni 记为 Anf1675 行，所列属、科、目为 Limnonectes、Dicroglossidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 2.9 g; maximum adult body length: 39.6 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：2.9 g；最大成体体长：39.6 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 10 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 29 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：10 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：29 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Limnonectes dammermani as row Anf1680, within Limnonectes, Dicroglossidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Limnonectes dammermani 记为 Anf1680 行，所列属、科、目为 Limnonectes、Dicroglossidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Limnonectes heinrichi as row Anf1690, within Limnonectes, Dicroglossidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Limnonectes heinrichi 记为 Anf1690 行，所列属、科、目为 Limnonectes、Dicroglossidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 75 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：75 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Limnonectes kenepaiensis as row Anf1695, within Limnonectes, Dicroglossidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Limnonectes kenepaiensis 记为 Anf1695 行，所列属、科、目为 Limnonectes、Dicroglossidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 38 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：38 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Limnonectes laticeps as row Anf1700, within Limnonectes, Dicroglossidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Limnonectes laticeps 记为 Anf1700 行，所列属、科、目为 Limnonectes、Dicroglossidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 53 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：53 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 265 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 265 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：265 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：265 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。
