limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Dendropsophus seniculus as row Anf2256, within Dendropsophus, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Dendropsophus seniculus 记为 Anf2256 行，所列属、科、目为 Dendropsophus、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 43 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：43 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Dendropsophus virolinensis as row Anf2265, within Dendropsophus, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 34 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Duellmanohyla rufioculis as row Anf2274, within Duellmanohyla, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Duellmanohyla rufioculis 记为 Anf2274 行，所列属、科、目为 Duellmanohyla、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 40 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：40 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 82 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 265 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.4 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：82 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：265 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2.4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.4 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Ecnomiohyla miotympanum as row Anf2283, within Ecnomiohyla, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 120 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 265 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.4 mm. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags dry and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyloscirtus chlorosteus as row Anf2344, within Hyloscirtus, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyloscirtus chlorosteus 记为 Anf2344 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyloscirtus、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 39.7 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：39.7 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyloscirtus platydactylus as row Anf2358, within Hyloscirtus, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyloscirtus platydactylus 记为 Anf2358 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyloscirtus、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 25 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 35 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.5 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.5 mm. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyloscirtus staufferorum as row Anf2363, within Hyloscirtus, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyloscirtus staufferorum 记为 Anf2363 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyloscirtus、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 59.7 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：59.7 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm; dry and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖；干暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 3.9 g; maximum adult body length: 43.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：3.9 g；最大成体体长：43.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 160 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 307 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.9 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：160 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：307 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：1.9 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hypsiboas bischoffi as row Anf2377, within Hypsiboas, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hypsiboas bischoffi 记为 Anf2377 行，所列属、科、目为 Hypsiboas、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm; wet and cold as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖；湿冷 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 69 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：69 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 491 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 850 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.8 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：491 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：850 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.8 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hypsiboas cymbalum as row Anf2390, within Hypsiboas, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hypsiboas cymbalum 记为 Anf2390 行，所列属、科、目为 Hypsiboas、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 50 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：50 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hypsiboas hobbsi as row Anf2403, within Hypsiboas, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hypsiboas hobbsi 记为 Anf2403 行，所列属、科、目为 Hypsiboas、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 42.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hypsiboas picturatus as row Anf2426, within Hypsiboas, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hypsiboas picturatus 记为 Anf2426 行，所列属、科、目为 Hypsiboas、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 69.4 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：69.4 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Isthmohyla lancasteri as row Anf2457, within Isthmohyla, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Isthmohyla lancasteri 记为 Anf2457 行，所列属、科、目为 Isthmohyla、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and cold as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿冷 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 41.1 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：41.1 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 70 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 80 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.6 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.6 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：70 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：80 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2.6 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.6 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Megastomatohyla mixe as row Anf2470, within Megastomatohyla, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Megastomatohyla mixe 记为 Anf2470 行，所列属、科、目为 Megastomatohyla、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 33.9 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：33.9 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Osteocephalus verruciger as row Anf2500, within Osteocephalus, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Osteocephalus verruciger 记为 Anf2500 行，所列属、科、目为 Osteocephalus、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 73 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：73 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

records.originalBibliography: Guyer and Boback 2011;Tacutu et al. 2012;Foden et al. 2013;Han and Fu 2013;Nali et al. 2013

bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

sourceConceptMapping.method: Exact scientific name, family and order candidate selection only; no equivalence asserted.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Osteopilus wilderi as row Anf2510, within Osteopilus, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Osteopilus wilderi 记为 Anf2510 行，所列属、科、目为 Osteopilus、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 29 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：29 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Phyllodytes kautskyi as row Anf2515, within Phyllodytes, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Phyllodytes kautskyi 记为 Anf2515 行，所列属、科、目为 Phyllodytes、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 38 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：38 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Plectrohyla avia as row Anf2526, within Plectrohyla, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Plectrohyla avia 记为 Anf2526 行，所列属、科、目为 Plectrohyla、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags twilight as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 晨昏 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 90.4 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：90.4 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Plectrohyla cembra as row Anf2531, within Plectrohyla, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Plectrohyla cembra 记为 Anf2531 行，所列属、科、目为 Plectrohyla、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 37 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：37 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Ptychohyla legleri as row Anf2597, within Ptychohyla, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Ptychohyla legleri 记为 Anf2597 行，所列属、科、目为 Ptychohyla、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 37 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：37 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Scinax chiquitanus as row Anf2635, within Scinax, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Scinax cuspidatus as row Anf2640, within Scinax, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Scinax cuspidatus 记为 Anf2640 行，所列属、科、目为 Scinax、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 32.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：32.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 55 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 286 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：55 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：286 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Scinax eurydice as row Anf2645, within Scinax, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Scinax eurydice 记为 Anf2645 行，所列属、科、目为 Scinax、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 53.8 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：53.8 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1486 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1913 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：1486 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：1913 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Scinax granulatus as row Anf2653, within Scinax, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Scinax granulatus 记为 Anf2653 行，所列属、科、目为 Scinax、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 43 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：43 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 700 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1700 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：700 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：1700 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Scinax nebulosus as row Anf2677, within Scinax, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Litoria cheesmani as row Anf2786, within Litoria, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Litoria cheesmani 记为 Anf2786 行，所列属、科、目为 Litoria、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 60 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：60 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.

The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 238 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 3054 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Litoria havina as row Anf2832, within Litoria, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Litoria havina 记为 Anf2832 行，所列属、科、目为 Litoria、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 38 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：38 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 3 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 36 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.5 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：3 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：36 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2.5 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Litoria manya as row Anf2862, within Litoria, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 1.63 g; maximum adult body length: 30 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 60 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 275 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 0.8 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 0.9 mm. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 11.35 g; maximum adult body length: 60 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 500 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1700 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.1 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.1 mm. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Litoria revelata as row Anf2912, within Litoria, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Litoria revelata 记为 Anf2912 行，所列属、科、目为 Litoria、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 0.93 g; maximum adult body length: 35 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 200 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1000 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：200 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：1000 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 30 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
