text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Phasmahyla exilis as row Anf2972, within Phasmahyla, Hylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Phasmahyla exilis 记为 Anf2972 行，所列属、科、目为 Phasmahyla、Hylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 34.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：34.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 30 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：30 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 33.6 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Afrixalus dorsalis as row Anf3060, within Afrixalus, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Afrixalus dorsalis 记为 Anf3060 行，所列属、科、目为 Afrixalus、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and cold as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿冷 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 38 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：38 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 66 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 100 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.7 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.2 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：66 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：100 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.7 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.2 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Afrixalus leucostictus as row Anf3069, within Afrixalus, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Afrixalus leucostictus 记为 Anf3069 行，所列属、科、目为 Afrixalus、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 36 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：36 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Afrixalus osorioi as row Anf3074, within Afrixalus, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Afrixalus osorioi 记为 Anf3074 行，所列属、科、目为 Afrixalus、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 35 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：35 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Alexteroon obstetricans as row Anf3088, within Alexteroon, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Alexteroon obstetricans 记为 Anf3088 行，所列属、科、目为 Alexteroon、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 31 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：31 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

sourceConceptMapping.method: Exact scientific name, family and order candidate selection only; no equivalence asserted.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Cryptothylax greshoffii as row Anf3093, within Cryptothylax, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Cryptothylax greshoffii 记为 Anf3093 行，所列属、科、目为 Cryptothylax、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 58 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：58 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 11 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 19 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：11 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：19 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 26 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 60 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 292 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 0.7 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.2 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyperolius camerunensis as row Anf3123, within Hyperolius, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyperolius camerunensis 记为 Anf3123 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyperolius、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyperolius cinnamomeoventris as row Anf3128, within Hyperolius, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyperolius cinnamomeoventris 记为 Anf3128 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyperolius、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 33 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：33 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 114 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 146 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.5 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：114 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：146 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.5 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：1.5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyperolius mosaicus as row Anf3172, within Hyperolius, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyperolius mosaicus 记为 Anf3172 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyperolius、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 27 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：27 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyperolius parallelus as row Anf3181, within Hyperolius, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hyperolius parallelus 记为 Anf3181 行，所列属、科、目为 Hyperolius、Hyperoliidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 35 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：35 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hyperolius punctulatus as row Anf3195, within Hyperolius, Hyperoliidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and cold as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿冷 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Physalaemus biligonigerus as row Anf3286, within Physalaemus, Leiuperidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Physalaemus biligonigerus 记为 Anf3286 行，所列属、科、目为 Physalaemus、Leiuperidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 40 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：40 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 332 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1688 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：332 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：1688 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：1 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Physalaemus moreirae as row Anf3314, within Physalaemus, Leiuperidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Physalaemus moreirae 记为 Anf3314 行，所列属、科、目为 Physalaemus、Leiuperidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 28.2 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：28.2 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Physalaemus riograndensis as row Anf3319, within Physalaemus, Leiuperidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Physalaemus riograndensis 记为 Anf3319 行，所列属、科、目为 Physalaemus、Leiuperidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 16.91 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：16.91 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 200 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 250 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 0.7 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 0.7 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：200 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：250 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：0.7 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：0.7 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Pleurodema brachyops as row Anf3328, within Pleurodema, Leiuperidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Pleurodema brachyops 记为 Anf3328 行，所列属、科、目为 Pleurodema、Leiuperidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 34.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：34.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 20 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 41 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 52 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.2 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.7 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 49 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：49 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 138 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 200 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.5 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 3 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：138 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：200 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2.5 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：3 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

sourceConceptMapping.method: Exact scientific name, family and order candidate selection only; no equivalence asserted.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptodactylus chaquensis as row Anf3366, within Leptodactylus, Leptodactylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Leptodactylus chaquensis 记为 Anf3366 行，所列属、科、目为 Leptodactylus、Leptodactylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 63 g; maximum adult body length: 82 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：63 g；最大成体体长：82 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 217 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 16234 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.7 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：217 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：16234 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：1.7 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptodactylus furnarius as row Anf3380, within Leptodactylus, Leptodactylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Leptodactylus furnarius 记为 Anf3380 行，所列属、科、目为 Leptodactylus、Leptodactylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags daytime; night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天；夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 44 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：44 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 27 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 119 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 3 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 3 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：27 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：119 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：3 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：3 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptodactylus melanonotus as row Anf3405, within Leptodactylus, Leptodactylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Leptodactylus melanonotus 记为 Anf3405 行，所列属、科、目为 Leptodactylus、Leptodactylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 58 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：58 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 18 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1500 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.3 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.3 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：18 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：1500 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.3 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：1.3 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptodactylus petersii as row Anf3418, within Leptodactylus, Leptodactylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Leptodactylus petersii 记为 Anf3418 行，所列属、科、目为 Leptodactylus、Leptodactylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags daytime; night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天；夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 4.2 g; maximum adult body length: 51 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：4.2 g；最大成体体长：51 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptodactylus rhodostima as row Anf3426, within Leptodactylus, Leptodactylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Leptodactylus rhodostima 记为 Anf3426 行，所列属、科、目为 Leptodactylus、Leptodactylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. text.en: The source flags daytime; night; twilight as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天；夜间；晨昏 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm; dry and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptodactylus viridis as row Anf3444, within Leptodactylus, Leptodactylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Leptodactylus viridis 记为 Anf3444 行，所列属、科、目为 Leptodactylus、Leptodactylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 78 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：78 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1000 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 3150 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：1000 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：3150 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：1.5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Paratelmatobius lutzii 记为 Anf3448 行，所列属、科、目为 Paratelmatobius、Leptodactylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 23.3 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：23.3 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 23 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 31 individuals/eggs; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.9 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.2 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：23 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：31 个/枚；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.9 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.2 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Heleioporus barycragus as row Anf3457, within Heleioporus, Limnodynastidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Heleioporus barycragus 记为 Anf3457 行，所列属、科、目为 Heleioporus、Limnodynastidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 86 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：86 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 420 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 420 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.7 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.7 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：420 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：420 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2.7 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.7 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Lechriodus aganoposis as row Anf3461, within Lechriodus, Limnodynastidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Lechriodus aganoposis 记为 Anf3461 行，所列属、科、目为 Lechriodus、Limnodynastidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 77 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：77 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Neobatrachus pictus as row Anf3481, within Neobatrachus, Limnodynastidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Neobatrachus pictus 记为 Anf3481 行，所列属、科、目为 Neobatrachus、Limnodynastidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 12.34 g; maximum adult body length: 50 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：12.34 g；最大成体体长：50 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1000 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 1000 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.2 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.2 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：1000 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：1000 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2.2 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.2 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Boophis erythrodactylus as row Anf3517, within Boophis, Mantellidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Boophis xerophilus 记为 Anf3568 行，所列属、科、目为 Boophis、Mantellidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 48.8 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：48.8 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 999 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 4235 individuals/eggs; minimum offspring or egg size: 0.9 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。
