text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Gephyromantis luteus as row Anf3598, within Gephyromantis, Mantellidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Gephyromantis luteus 记为 Anf3598 行，所列属、科、目为 Gephyromantis、Mantellidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 60 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：60 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Guibemantis kathrinae as row Anf3622, within Guibemantis, Mantellidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Mantella madagascariensis 记为 Anf3638 行，所列属、科、目为 Mantella、Mantellidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 31 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：31 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Mantidactylus mocquardi as row Anf3666, within Mantidactylus, Mantellidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Mantidactylus mocquardi 记为 Anf3666 行，所列属、科、目为 Mantidactylus、Mantellidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 67 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：67 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptobrachium guangxiense as row Anf3706, within Leptobrachium, Megophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptobrachium montanum as row Anf3716, within Leptobrachium, Megophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 217 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 217 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Leptolalax croceus as row Anf3732, within Leptolalax, Megophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.zh: 来源将 夜间；晨昏 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 31.6 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：31.6 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Xenophrys kuatunensis as row Anf3818, within Xenophrys, Megophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Xenophrys kuatunensis 记为 Anf3818 行，所列属、科、目为 Xenophrys、Megophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 37.4 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：37.4 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Xenophrys palpebralespinosa as row Anf3828, within Xenophrys, Megophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Xenophrys palpebralespinosa 记为 Anf3828 行，所列属、科、目为 Xenophrys、Megophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 38 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：38 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Xenophrys wuliangshanensis as row Anf3840, within Xenophrys, Megophryidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Xenophrys wuliangshanensis 记为 Anf3840 行，所列属、科、目为 Xenophrys、Megophryidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 41.3 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：41.3 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Micrixalus saxicola as row Anf3851, within Micrixalus, Micrixalidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Micrixalus saxicola 记为 Anf3851 行，所列属、科、目为 Micrixalus、Micrixalidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Synapturanus salseri as row Anf3870, within Synapturanus, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Synapturanus salseri 记为 Anf3870 行，所列属、科、目为 Synapturanus、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags daytime; night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天；夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm; dry and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖；干暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 35 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：35 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 8 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 8 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 4 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：8 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：8 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：4 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Albericus brunhildae as row Anf3874, within Albericus, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Albericus brunhildae 记为 Anf3874 行，所列属、科、目为 Albericus、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 21.1 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：21.1 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Albericus siegfriedi as row Anf3884, within Albericus, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. scope.en: Dataset-wide revision notice; affected original rows remain unverified.

bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

sourceConceptMapping.method: Exact scientific name, family and order candidate selection only; no equivalence asserted.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Asterophrys turpicola as row Anf3893, within Asterophrys, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Asterophrys turpicola 记为 Anf3893 行，所列属、科、目为 Asterophrys、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Austrochaperina basipalmata as row Anf3898, within Austrochaperina, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Austrochaperina basipalmata 记为 Anf3898 行，所列属、科、目为 Austrochaperina、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags daytime as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 39 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：39 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Barygenys parvula as row Anf3925, within Barygenys, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Barygenys parvula 记为 Anf3925 行，所列属、科、目为 Barygenys、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 18.7 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：18.7 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Callulops eremnosphax as row Anf3930, within Callulops, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Callulops eremnosphax 记为 Anf3930 行，所列属、科、目为 Callulops、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 42.7 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：42.7 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Callulops marmoratus as row Anf3935, within Callulops, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Callulops marmoratus 记为 Anf3935 行，所列属、科、目为 Callulops、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 53.3 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：53.3 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Callulops stictogaster as row Anf3940, within Callulops, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Callulops stictogaster 记为 Anf3940 行，所列属、科、目为 Callulops、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Choerophryne burtoni as row Anf3945, within Choerophryne, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Choerophryne burtoni 记为 Anf3945 行，所列属、科、目为 Choerophryne、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：12.4 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Cophixalus monticola as row Anf3980, within Cophixalus, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Cophixalus monticola 记为 Anf3980 行，所列属、科、目为 Cophixalus、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 11 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 11 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 50 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Copiula fistulans as row Anf4005, within Copiula, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Copiula fistulans 记为 Anf4005 行，所列属、科、目为 Copiula、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 湿暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 36 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：36 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags wet and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Liophryne rhododactyla as row Anf4025, within Liophryne, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Oninia senglaubi as row Anf4035, within Oninia, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 18.8 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Oreophryne anulata as row Anf4040, within Oreophryne, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Oreophryne anulata 记为 Anf4040 行，所列属、科、目为 Oreophryne、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 3 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 9 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 3 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 4 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：3 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：9 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：3 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：4 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Oreophryne inornata 记为 Anf4059 行，所列属、科、目为 Oreophryne、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 41 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：41 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum size at sexual maturity: 19 mm; maximum size at sexual maturity: 21 mm. text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Xenorhina macrodisca as row Anf4104, within Xenorhina, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Xenorhina macrodisca 记为 Anf4104 行，所列属、科、目为 Xenorhina、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 41.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：41.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum offspring or egg size: 2.7 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.7 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 后代或卵的最小尺寸：2.7 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.7 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Xenorhina obesa as row Anf4109, within Xenorhina, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Xenorhina obesa 记为 Anf4109 行，所列属、科、目为 Xenorhina、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 72.3 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：72.3 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 4.4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5.5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：4.4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：5.5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Anodonthyla nigrigularis as row Anf4128, within Anodonthyla, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Anodonthyla nigrigularis 记为 Anf4128 行，所列属、科、目为 Anodonthyla、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 21.7 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：21.7 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Cophyla berara as row Anf4133, within Cophyla, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Cophyla berara 记为 Anf4133 行，所列属、科、目为 Cophyla、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Platypelis barbouri as row Anf4138, within Platypelis, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

scope.en: Dataset-wide revision notice; affected original rows remain unverified.
scope.zh: 数据集层级修订说明；受影响原始行尚未核定。

bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

sourceConceptMapping.method: Exact scientific name, family and order candidate selection only; no equivalence asserted.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Rhombophryne coronata as row Anf4157, within Rhombophryne, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Rhombophryne coronata 记为 Anf4157 行，所列属、科、目为 Rhombophryne、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 0.16 g; maximum adult body length: 24.4 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 123 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 395 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 0.94 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.37 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：123 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：395 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：0.94 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：1.37 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Kalophrynus robinsoni as row Anf4250, within Kalophrynus, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 18 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Kaloula kokacii as row Anf4269, within Kaloula, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Kaloula kokacii 记为 Anf4269 行，所列属、科、目为 Kaloula、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Microhyla annectens as row Anf4282, within Microhyla, Microhylidae, Anura. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Microhyla annectens 记为 Anf4282 行，所列属、科、目为 Microhyla、Microhylidae、Anura。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 18 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：18 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。
