text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Ambystoma dumerilii as row Anf5981, within Ambystoma, Ambystomatidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Ambystoma dumerilii 记为 Anf5981 行，所列属、科、目为 Ambystoma、Ambystomatidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 282 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：282 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Andrias davidianus as row Anf6012, within Andrias, Cryptobranchidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Andrias davidianus 记为 Anf6012 行，所列属、科、目为 Andrias、Cryptobranchidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 4100 g; maximum adult body length: 900 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum size at sexual maturity: 100 mm; maximum size at sexual maturity: 100 mm; maximum lifespan: 19.9 years; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 300 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 600 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 5 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 9 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Batrachuperus yenyuanensis as row Anf6020, within Batrachuperus, Hynobiidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags fossorial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 16 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 50 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Hynobius turkestanicus as row Anf6049, within Hynobius, Hynobiidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Hynobius turkestanicus 记为 Anf6049 行，所列属、科、目为 Hynobius、Hynobiidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum age at sexual maturity: 2 years; maximum age at sexual maturity: 3 years; maximum lifespan: 11 years; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 66 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 86 individuals/eggs; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.7 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.9 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 性成熟最小年龄：2 年；性成熟最大年龄：3 年；最大寿命：11 年；每窝后代或卵的最小数量：66 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：86 个/枚；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2.7 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2.9 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Liua tsinpaensis as row Anf6054, within Liua, Hynobiidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Liua tsinpaensis 记为 Anf6054 行，所列属、科、目为 Liua、Hynobiidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 136.1 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：136.1 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 6 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 11 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 5 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：6 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：11 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：5 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Batrachoseps pacificus 记为 Anf6082 行，所列属、科、目为 Batrachoseps、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 135 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：135 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum age at sexual maturity: 3.5 years; maximum age at sexual maturity: 3.5 years; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 性成熟最小年龄：3.5 年；性成熟最大年龄：3.5 年；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Bolitoglossa alvaradoi as row Anf6092, within Bolitoglossa, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Bolitoglossa alvaradoi 记为 Anf6092 行，所列属、科、目为 Bolitoglossa、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 155 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：155 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Bolitoglossa equatoriana as row Anf6119, within Bolitoglossa, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Bolitoglossa equatoriana 记为 Anf6119 行，所列属、科、目为 Bolitoglossa、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags dry and warm as present categories. Seasonal categories compare conditions during activity with the local annual climate; they are not fixed calendar months worldwide.
text.zh: 来源将 干暖 标记为已记录的类别。季节类别将活动时的环境与当地全年气候比较，不对应全球固定的历月。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 52 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：52 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Bolitoglossa platydactyla as row Anf6172, within Bolitoglossa, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Bolitoglossa platydactyla 记为 Anf6172 行，所列属、科、目为 Bolitoglossa、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 145 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：145 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Bolitoglossa sooyorum as row Anf6188, within Bolitoglossa, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Bolitoglossa suchitanensis as row Anf6193, within Bolitoglossa, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Bolitoglossa suchitanensis 记为 Anf6193 行，所列属、科、目为 Bolitoglossa、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 90.2 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：90.2 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

bibliographyAlignment.method: Exact Order, Family, Genus and Species fields within the same deposited dataset; original row IDs retained separately.

sourceConceptMapping.method: Exact scientific name, family and order candidate selection only; no equivalence asserted.

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Chiropterotriton cracens as row Anf6210, within Chiropterotriton, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Chiropterotriton cracens 记为 Anf6210 行，所列属、科、目为 Chiropterotriton、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 73.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：73.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Chiropterotriton multidentatus as row Anf6215, within Chiropterotriton, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Chiropterotriton multidentatus 记为 Anf6215 行，所列属、科、目为 Chiropterotriton、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 102.6 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：102.6 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Dendrotriton sanctibarbarus as row Anf6232, within Dendrotriton, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Dendrotriton sanctibarbarus 记为 Anf6232 行，所列属、科、目为 Dendrotriton、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 84 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：84 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Nototriton gamezi as row Anf6237, within Nototriton, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Nototriton gamezi 记为 Anf6237 行，所列属、科、目为 Nototriton、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 54 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：54 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Nototriton picadoi as row Anf6242, within Nototriton, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Nototriton picadoi 记为 Anf6242 行，所列属、科、目为 Nototriton、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 66 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：66 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Oedipina gephyra as row Anf6258, within Oedipina, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Oedipina gephyra 记为 Anf6258 行，所列属、科、目为 Oedipina、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 188 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：188 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Pseudoeurycea ahuitzotl as row Anf6279, within Pseudoeurycea, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Pseudoeurycea ahuitzotl 记为 Anf6279 行，所列属、科、目为 Pseudoeurycea、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.

text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Pseudoeurycea nigromaculata 记为 Anf6310 行，所列属、科、目为 Pseudoeurycea、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; arboreal as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；树栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 121.5 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：121.5 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Pseudoeurycea saltator as row Anf6321, within Pseudoeurycea, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Pseudoeurycea saltator 记为 Anf6321 行，所列属、科、目为 Pseudoeurycea、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Pseudoeurycea tlahcuiloh as row Anf6326, within Pseudoeurycea, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Pseudoeurycea tlahcuiloh 记为 Anf6326 行，所列属、科、目为 Pseudoeurycea、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 穴居；陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 126.2 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：126.2 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Plethodon angusticlavius as row Anf6393, within Plethodon, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Plethodon angusticlavius 记为 Anf6393 行，所列属、科、目为 Plethodon、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 1.2 g; maximum adult body length: 79 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：1.2 g；最大成体体长：79 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 3 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 9 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：3 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：9 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 111 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum size at sexual maturity: 50 mm; maximum size at sexual maturity: 60 mm; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 3 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 9 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5 mm. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Plethodon glutinosus as row Anf6407, within Plethodon, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Plethodon glutinosus 记为 Anf6407 行，所列属、科、目为 Plethodon、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 65 g; maximum adult body length: 206 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：65 g；最大成体体长：206 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum age at sexual maturity: 2.5 years; maximum age at sexual maturity: 2.5 years; minimum size at sexual maturity: 48 mm; maximum size at sexual maturity: 48 mm; maximum lifespan: 20.1 years; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 34 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 34 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 性成熟最小年龄：2.5 年；性成熟最大年龄：2.5 年；性成熟最小体长：48 mm；性成熟最大体长：48 mm；最大寿命：20.1 年；每窝后代或卵的最小数量：34 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：34 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Plethodon idahoensis as row Anf6411, within Plethodon, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Plethodon idahoensis 记为 Anf6411 行，所列属、科、目为 Plethodon、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 130 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：130 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Plethodon sequoyah as row Anf6429, within Plethodon, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Plethodon sequoyah 记为 Anf6429 行，所列属、科、目为 Plethodon、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 148 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：148 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum offspring or egg size: 4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 后代或卵的最小尺寸：4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.
limitations.zh: 本页是存档性状汇编的读本。NA 保留为缺失数据；未列出的类别不能据此推断为不存在。逐性状原始出处、现代分类概念核对及七主题科学档案审阅尚未完成；没有外部专家审评。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Plethodon stormi as row Anf6434, within Plethodon, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Plethodon stormi 记为 Anf6434 行，所列属、科、目为 Plethodon、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 140 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：140 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：4 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Eurycea wilderae as row Anf6478, within Eurycea, Plethodontidae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Eurycea wilderae 记为 Anf6478 行，所列属、科、目为 Eurycea、Plethodontidae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 96 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：96 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum age at sexual maturity: 3 years; maximum age at sexual maturity: 4 years; minimum size at sexual maturity: 25 mm; maximum size at sexual maturity: 92 mm; maximum lifespan: 5 years; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 8 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 56 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 性成熟最小年龄：3 年；性成熟最大年龄：4 年；性成熟最小体长：25 mm；性成熟最大体长：92 mm；最大寿命：5 年；每窝后代或卵的最小数量：8 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：56 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

limitations.en: This is a reader for a deposited trait compilation. NA remains missing data; unlisted categories are not inferred absent. Per-trait primary citations, modern taxonomic reconciliation and seven-facet scientific dossier review remain incomplete. No external expert review.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Lissotriton italicus as row Anf6517, within Lissotriton, Salamandridae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Lissotriton italicus 记为 Anf6517 行，所列属、科、目为 Lissotriton、Salamandridae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 0.98 g; maximum adult body length: 80 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：0.98 g；最大成体体长：80 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 400 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 400 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.5 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 1.5 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：400 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：400 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：1.5 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：1.5 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum age at sexual maturity: 2 years; maximum age at sexual maturity: 3.3 years; maximum lifespan: 16 years; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 1.8 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.3 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Taricha rivularis as row Anf6550, within Taricha, Salamandridae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum age at sexual maturity: 4 years; maximum age at sexual maturity: 10 years; minimum size at sexual maturity: 140 mm; maximum size at sexual maturity: 200 mm; maximum lifespan: 30 years; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 6 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 16 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2.4 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2.7 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Triturus cristatus as row Anf6555, within Triturus, Salamandridae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Triturus cristatus 记为 Anf6555 行，所列属、科、目为 Triturus、Salamandridae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: The source flags arthropods; vertebrates, including cannibalism in the source definition as present categories. The dataset aggregates adult diet categories from literature reports of expert judgement, observation or stomach contents. A listed category is not a complete diet or a measured diet proportion.
text.zh: 来源将 节肢动物；脊椎动物，来源定义包括同类相食 标记为已记录的类别。数据集从文献中的专家判断、观察或胃内容物记录汇总成体食物类别。某类别被记录，不表示完整食谱或实测食物比例。

text.en: The source flags daytime; night as present categories. These are overall activity categories rather than a continuous behavioural time series.
text.zh: 来源将 白天；夜间 标记为已记录的类别。这些是总体活动类别，不是连续的行为时间序列。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body mass: 15 g; maximum adult body length: 150 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体重：15 g；最大成体体长：150 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum age at sexual maturity: 2 years; maximum age at sexual maturity: 4 years; maximum lifespan: 28 years; minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 70 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 600 individuals/eggs; maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year; minimum offspring or egg size: 2 mm; maximum offspring or egg size: 2 mm. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 性成熟最小年龄：2 年；性成熟最大年龄：4 年；最大寿命：28 年；每窝后代或卵的最小数量：70 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：600 个/枚；每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年；后代或卵的最小尺寸：2 mm；后代或卵的最大尺寸：2 mm。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags a larval stage. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 具有幼体阶段。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Triturus marmoratus as row Anf6559, within Triturus, Salamandridae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.

Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.

text.en: AmphiBIO v1 records Lyciasalamandra billae as row Anf6572, within Lyciasalamandra, Salamandridae, Caudata. Its species concepts follow Amphibian Species of the World (Frost 2011). The following traits describe that deposited source record; correspondence to a current COL26.8 species concept has not been established.
text.zh: AmphiBIO v1 将 Lyciasalamandra billae 记为 Anf6572 行，所列属、科、目为 Lyciasalamandra、Salamandridae、Caudata。物种概念依据 Amphibian Species of the World（Frost 2011）。以下性状描述这条存档来源记录，尚未确定其与当前 COL26.8 物种概念的对应关系。

text.en: The source flags terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. A later TetrapodTraits revision reports correcting some amphibian body-mass and microhabitat entries propagated from earlier compilations. The affected row-level comparison has not yet been captured here. This deposited historical value or category requires review before reuse; no replacement value is inferred, and this notice does not identify every original entry as erroneous.
text.zh: 来源将 陆栖；水栖 标记为已记录的类别。这些是概括性的觅食类别；汇编没有详细区分季节变化或发育阶段变化。后续 TetrapodTraits 修订报告纠正了从早期汇编传播的部分两栖动物体重与微栖地记录。此处尚未取得受影响行的逐项比对；这些存档历史值或类别在再利用前需要核对。没有推断替代值，本说明也不把每条原记录判为错误。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum adult body length: 139 mm. Body length means snout–vent length for Anura and total length for Caudata and Gymnophiona. These are compiled maximum adult values, not measurements of every individual.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 最大成体体长：139 mm。体长在无尾目指吻肛长，在有尾目和蚓螈目指全长。这些是汇编的最大成体值，不是每一个体的测量值。

text.en: AmphiBIO reports maximum reproductive events per year: 1 events/year. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每年最多繁殖次数：1 次/年。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags viviparity. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 胎生。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。

text.en: The source flags fossorial; terrestrial; aquatic as present categories. These are broad foraging categories; the compilation does not describe seasonal or developmental changes in detail. text.en: AmphiBIO reports minimum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 5 individuals/eggs; maximum number of offspring or eggs per clutch: 15 individuals/eggs. The dataset compiles extrema and counts from literature; the row does not separately specify sex, population, measurement date or wild versus captive conditions for each value. Offspring-size values may refer to offspring or eggs.
text.zh: AmphiBIO 记载 每窝后代或卵的最小数量：5 个/枚；每窝后代或卵的最大数量：15 个/枚。数据集从文献汇编极值和计数；本行没有逐值区分性别、种群、测量日期或野生与圈养条件。后代尺寸字段可能指后代或卵。

text.en: The deposited record flags direct development. These source categories do not by themselves describe parental care, breeding location or seasonal timing.
text.zh: 存档记录标记 直接发育。这些来源类别本身不足以说明亲代照料、繁殖地点或季节时序。
